description: Defines classes for reading from and writing to Mojo data pipes, including MojoDataPipeReader and MojoDataPipeWriter, with methods for asynchronous data transfer and pipe management.

classes.name: MojoDataPipeReader
classes.description: Handles reading data asynchronously from a Mojo data pipe.

classes.name: MojoDataPipeWriter
classes.description: Handles writing data asynchronously to a Mojo data pipe.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the data pipe into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bytes from a buffer into the data pipe.

methods.name: IsPipeValid
methods.description: Checks if the data pipe is currently valid.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Unbinds the data pipe, invalidating it.
